Contract Generator.contract:
Contract CoCoMESystem::changePrice(barcode: Integer,newPrice: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		oItem: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(o|o.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		oItem.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		oItem.Price = newPrice and
		result = true or
		oItem.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = false
}
